lore.short_description: While raging and not wearing armor, you gain a bonus Dash action and have incoming attacks at a disadvantage.
lore.full_text: While you're raging and aren't wearing heavy armor, other creatures have disadvantage on opportunity attack rolls against you, and you can use the Dash action as a bonus action on your turn. The spirit of the eagle makes you into a predator who can weave through the fray with ease.
